name: com.gamecore.gameplay.logic
description: Catalog row 9 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.4): reusable rules and logic, and the narrative composition shared by dialogue, quests and inventory. Authoring: ConditionSetDefinition, ActionSetDefinition, RuleDefinition and the GameplayContentSet of a world (baked to a GameplayContentManifest). Kernel half: the logic.fired/cooldownMs/counter rule slots, the logic.evaluate and logic.runActions routes and the RuleFired/RuleSkipped/ActionsRun/ActionDue events, in a logic stage that runs after the gameplay stages. Runtime: NarrativeComposer (adds the narrative plugins to the P1.1 world plan), the narrative host stage (trigger routing, quest signals, delivery), the narrative outbox (every outbox-only action and reward delivered exactly once), the 256-entry explain trace (IExplainSource), IConditionEvaluator and IActionRunner. Editor: logic.addRule, logic.explain and logic.test, and the narrative bake extension.
